scenarios.title: In an isolated Quirky profile with a disposable fake-agent history fixture, Resume in Worktree opens the intended terminal tab and transfers native keyboard focus to that pane without activating an unrelated window.
Reveal Log for a disposable local history fixture selects that exact transcript in Finder; Open Working Directory opens its original existing directory, with no launch of a different session or log.

Copy Resume Command, Session ID, Log Path and full First Prompt place the selected fixture's complete literal text on the macOS clipboard; verify spaces/apostrophes/metacharacters and restore the prior clipboard afterwards.
